εἷς
ιά, ἕν, genitive ἑνός, μιᾶς, ἑνός,
cardinal numeral, one;
__1. one, as opposite to many: Mat.25:15, Rom.5:12, 1Co.10:8, al.; as subst., Rom.5:15, Eph.2:14; id. with genitive partit., Mat.5:19, al.; before ἐκ (ἐξ), Mrk.14:18, Jhn.6:8, al.; metaphorically, of union and concord, Jhn.10:30 17:11, Rom.12:4-5, Php.1:27; ἀπὸ μιᾶς (B1., § 44, 1), Luk.14:18; with neg., εἷς. . . οὐ (μή), more emphatic than οὐδείς, no one, none (cl.), Mat.5:18 10:29, Luk.11:46 12:6.
__2. Emphatically, to the exclusion of others;
__(a) a single (one): Mat.21:24, Mrk.8:14; absol., 1Co.9:24, al.; οὐδὲ εἷς, Mat.27:14, Jhn.1:3, Rom.3:10, al.;
__(b) one, alone: Mrk.2:7 10:18, Luk.18:19;
__(with) one and the same: Rom.3:30, 1Co.3:8 11:5 12:11, 1Jn.5:8.
__3. In late Gk., with weakened force, = τις or indef. art. (of. Heb. אֶחָד, Gen.22:13, al.; see B1., § 45, 2; M, Pr., 96 f.): Mat.8:19 19:6, Rev.8:13, al.; εἷς τις (Bl., l.with), Luk.22:50, Jhn.11:49
__4. Distributively: εἷς καστος (cl.), Luk.4:40, Act.2:6, al.; εἷς . . . καὶ εἷς (cl., εἷς μὲν . . . εἷς δέ), Mat.17:4, Mrk.9:5, Jhn.20:12, al. (cf. LXX and use of Heb. אֶחָד, Exo.17:12, al); ὁ εἷς . . . ὁ ἕτερος (ἄλλος) = cl. ὁ μὲν (ἕτερος) . . . ὁ δέ (ἕτερος), Mat.6:24, Luk.7:41, Rev.17:10; καθ᾽ εἷς, εἷς κ. είς (in which καθ᾽ is adverbial, or the expression formed from the analogy of ἕν καθ᾽ ἔν; M, Pr., 105), one by one, severally: Mrk.14:19, Rom.12:5, al.; εἷς τὸν ἕνα = ἀλλήλους (B1., 45, 2; M, Pr., 246), 1Th.5:11.
__5. As ordinal = πρῶτος (like Heb. אֶחָד; Bl., § 45, 1; M, Pr., 95 f.), first: Mat.28:1, Mrk.16:2, al
(AS)

occurrences.bsb: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
occurrences.kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

occurrences.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

occurrences.bsb: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

occurrences.bsb: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
occurrences.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

occurrences.bsb: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

occurrences.bsb: No one can serve two masters: Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.
occurrences.kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

occurrences.bsb: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
occurrences.kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

occurrences.bsb: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
occurrences.kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

occurrences.bsb: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
occurrences.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”
occurrences.kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

occurrences.bsb: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
occurrences.kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

occurrences.bsb: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

occurrences.bsb: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
occurrences.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

occurrences.bsb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
occurrences.kjv: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
occurrences.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

occurrences.bsb: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.
occurrences.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
occurrences.kjv: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

occurrences.bsb: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
occurrences.kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
occurrences.kjv: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

occurrences.bsb: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
occurrences.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

occurrences.bsb: As he began the settlements, a debtor owing ten thousand talents was brought to him.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

occurrences.bsb: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
occurrences.kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

occurrences.bsb: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
occurrences.kjv: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

occurrences.bsb: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

occurrences.bsb: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

occurrences.bsb: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

occurrences.bsb: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day.’
occurrences.kjv: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

occurrences.bsb: But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Did you not agree with me on one denarius?
occurrences.kjv: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

occurrences.bsb: “What do you want?” He inquired. She answered, “Declare that in Your kingdom one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand, and the other at Your left.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

occurrences.bsb: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.
occurrences.kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

occurrences.bsb: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

occurrences.bsb: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:
occurrences.kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

occurrences.bsb: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
occurrences.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

occurrences.bsb: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You traverse land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.
occurrences.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

occurrences.bsb: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
occurrences.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

occurrences.bsb: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
occurrences.kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

occurrences.bsb: To one he gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent—each according to his own ability. And he went on his journey.
occurrences.kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

occurrences.bsb: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
occurrences.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
occurrences.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

occurrences.bsb: And the King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.’
occurrences.kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

occurrences.bsb: Then the King will answer, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me.’
occurrences.kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the Twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
occurrences.kjv: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

occurrences.bsb: And while they were eating, He said to them, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

occurrences.bsb: They were deeply grieved and began to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord?”
occurrences.kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?” He asked Peter.
occurrences.kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.
occurrences.kjv: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

occurrences.bsb: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him. “You also were with Jesus the Galilean,” she said.
occurrences.kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus gave no answer, not even to a single charge, much to the governor’s amazement.
occurrences.kjv: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

occurrences.bsb: Now it was the governor’s custom at the feast to release to the crowd a prisoner of their choosing.
occurrences.kjv: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

occurrences.bsb: Two robbers were crucified with Him, one on His right and the other on His left.
occurrences.kjv: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

occurrences.bsb: One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge. He filled it with sour wine, put it on a reed, and held it up for Jesus to drink.
occurrences.kjv: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

occurrences.bsb: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
occurrences.kjv: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

occurrences.bsb: “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
occurrences.kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

occurrences.bsb: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”
occurrences.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

occurrences.bsb: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”
occurrences.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

occurrences.bsb: A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

occurrences.bsb: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
occurrences.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
occurrences.kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

occurrences.bsb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
occurrences.kjv: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
occurrences.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

occurrences.bsb: Someone in the crowd replied, “Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.
occurrences.kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

occurrences.bsb: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes not only Me, but the One who sent Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

occurrences.bsb: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
occurrences.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

occurrences.bsb: As Jesus started on His way, a man ran up and knelt before Him. “Good Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
occurrences.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

occurrences.bsb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

occurrences.bsb: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”
occurrences.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

occurrences.bsb: “I will ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
occurrences.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

occurrences.bsb: Now one of the scribes had come up and heard their debate. Noticing how well Jesus had answered them, he asked Him, “Which commandment is the most important of all?”
occurrences.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “This is the most important: ‘Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

occurrences.bsb: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
occurrences.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

occurrences.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

occurrences.bsb: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
occurrences.kjv: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

occurrences.bsb: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
occurrences.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

occurrences.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

occurrences.bsb: They began to be grieved and to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I?”
occurrences.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

occurrences.bsb: He answered, “It is one of the Twelve—the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with Me.
occurrences.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus returned and found them sleeping. “Simon, are you asleep?” He asked. “Were you not able to keep watch for one hour?
occurrences.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

occurrences.bsb: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
occurrences.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

occurrences.bsb: He who plants and he who waters are one in purpose, and each will be rewarded according to his own labor.
occurrences.kjv: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us not to go beyond what is written. Then you will not take pride in one man over another.
occurrences.kjv: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.

occurrences.bsb: Or don’t you know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, “The two will become one flesh.”
occurrences.kjv: What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh.

occurrences.bsb: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with Him in spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

occurrences.bsb: So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
occurrences.kjv: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.

occurrences.bsb: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. And there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
occurrences.kjv: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
occurrences.kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

occurrences.bsb: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
occurrences.kjv: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

occurrences.bsb: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
occurrences.kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

occurrences.bsb: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
occurrences.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

occurrences.bsb: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,
occurrences.kjv: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

occurrences.bsb: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines.
occurrences.kjv: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

occurrences.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
occurrences.kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
occurrences.kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.

occurrences.bsb: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.
occurrences.kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

occurrences.bsb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
occurrences.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

occurrences.bsb: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
occurrences.kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.

occurrences.bsb: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
occurrences.kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.
occurrences.kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

occurrences.bsb: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
occurrences.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

occurrences.bsb: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
occurrences.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

occurrences.bsb: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
occurrences.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

occurrences.bsb: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

occurrences.bsb: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
occurrences.kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

occurrences.bsb: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

occurrences.bsb: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.
occurrences.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

occurrences.bsb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
occurrences.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

occurrences.bsb: These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
occurrences.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

occurrences.bsb: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
occurrences.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

occurrences.bsb: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
occurrences.kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

occurrences.bsb: by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace
occurrences.kjv: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

occurrences.bsb: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He put to death their hostility.
occurrences.kjv: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

occurrences.bsb: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

occurrences.bsb: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
occurrences.kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

occurrences.bsb: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
occurrences.kjv: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

occurrences.bsb: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
occurrences.kjv: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

occurrences.bsb: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.
occurrences.kjv: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

occurrences.bsb: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
occurrences.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending together as one for the faith of the gospel,
occurrences.kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

occurrences.bsb: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
occurrences.kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

occurrences.bsb: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
occurrences.kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

occurrences.bsb: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
occurrences.kjv: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

occurrences.bsb: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—
occurrences.kjv: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

occurrences.bsb: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

occurrences.bsb: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
occurrences.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

occurrences.bsb: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
occurrences.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

occurrences.bsb: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
occurrences.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

occurrences.bsb: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
occurrences.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

occurrences.bsb: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to her husband,
occurrences.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

occurrences.bsb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
occurrences.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

occurrences.bsb: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
occurrences.kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

occurrences.bsb: For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.
occurrences.kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

occurrences.bsb: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

occurrences.bsb: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.
occurrences.kjv: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

occurrences.bsb: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

occurrences.bsb: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
occurrences.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

occurrences.bsb: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
occurrences.kjv: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

occurrences.bsb: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
occurrences.kjv: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
occurrences.kjv: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

occurrences.bsb: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
occurrences.kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

occurrences.bsb: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
occurrences.kjv: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.”
occurrences.kjv: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

occurrences.bsb: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, “Come!”
occurrences.kjv: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the elders addressed me: “These in white robes,” he asked, “who are they, and where have they come from?”
occurrences.kjv: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

occurrences.bsb: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”
occurrences.kjv: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

occurrences.bsb: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to follow.
occurrences.kjv: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

occurrences.bsb: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God
occurrences.kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

occurrences.bsb: One of the heads of the beast appeared to have been mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.
occurrences.kjv: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
occurrences.kjv: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.
occurrences.kjv: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:

occurrences.bsb: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. But when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
occurrences.kjv: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.

occurrences.bsb: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings along with the beast.
occurrences.kjv: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

occurrences.bsb: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
occurrences.kjv: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.

occurrences.bsb: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
occurrences.kjv: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore her plagues will come in one day—death and grief and famine—and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.

occurrences.bsb: In fear of her torment, they will stand at a distance and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, the mighty city of Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come.”
occurrences.kjv: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

occurrences.bsb: For in a single hour such fabulous wealth has been destroyed!” Every shipmaster, passenger, and sailor, and all who make their living from the sea, will stand at a distance
occurrences.kjv: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

occurrences.bsb: Then they will throw dust on their heads as they weep and mourn and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, where all who had ships on the sea were enriched by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been destroyed.”
occurrences.kjv: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

occurrences.bsb: Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying: “With such violence the great city of Babylon will be cast down, never to be seen again.
occurrences.kjv: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.

occurrences.bsb: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
occurrences.kjv: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

occurrences.bsb: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
occurrences.kjv: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb’s wife.

occurrences.bsb: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.
occurrences.kjv: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
